page_title: LEV 2-2 BET | Levante v Betis 14/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Alejandro Ruiz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Betis out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
90+8' Alvaro Valles (Betis) threads a pass through to Cedric Bakambu, but Mathew Ryan breaks up the move.
90+6' Roger Brugue (Levante) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
90+5' Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+5' Natan (Betis) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+4' The linesman signals that Goduine Koyalipou (Levante) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+4' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is flagged for offside.
90+2' Manu Sanchez (Levante) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+1' Levante take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

89' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Mathew Ryan guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
87' Here is a change. Cucho Hernandez is going off and Manuel Pellegrini gives the last tactical orders to Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
87' Valentin Gomez (Betis) commits a foul during an attacking move.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Kervin Arriaga (Levante) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Martinez Andres.
81' 2 - 2 Goal! A great cross from Abde Ezzalzouli finds Pablo Fornals (Betis), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 2:2.
80' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Betis will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the top left corner, but Mathew Ryan is alert and thwarts the effort.
78' Dela (Levante) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
77' A cooling break is underway.
75' Valentin Gomez (Betis) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
75' Betis earn a corner.
75' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
74' One of the players from Levante times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
73' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Sofyan Amrabat (Betis) replaces Sergi Altimira.
72' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) on for Rodrigo Riquelme.
72' Antony (Betis) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
71' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
69' Mathew Ryan (Levante) picks up a yellow card.
68' Antony (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
68' Betis are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
66' Dela (Levante) comes onto the pitch because Matias Moreno simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
66' Ivan Romero comes off the pitch to be replaced by Goduine Koyalipou (Levante).
65' Matias Moreno (Levante) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
64' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
64' Hector Bellerin (Betis) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Cucho Hernandez was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball.
63' Yellow card. Ivan Romero (Levante) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
62' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roger Brugue (Levante) replacing Jon Ander Olasagasti.
62' Jose Morales (Levante) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Etta Eyong.
62' The game is interrupted now, Etta Eyong (Levante) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
60' Mathew Ryan (Levante) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
59' Mathew Ryan (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' Antony (Betis) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
56' One of the Betis players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
55' Junior Firpo (Betis) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
52' Mathew Ryan displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
52' The ball is out of play. Levante win a corner kick.
51' Levante are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hector Bellerin (Betis) was quite harsh and Alejandro Ruiz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' The referee blows his whistle, Levante are awarded a corner kick.
50' Levante have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Etta Eyong (Levante) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
48' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Betis.
47' Antony (Betis) serves up a nice cross, but Mathew Ryan punches the ball away.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is coming on in place of Nelson Deossa at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+8' What a wasted opportunity by Antony (Betis)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Mathew Ryan makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
45+7' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
45+6' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jon Ander Olasagasti (Levante) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
45+5' Junior Firpo (Betis) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
45+2' 2 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
45+1' We will have 7 min. of added time.
44' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Antony (Betis) causes Mathew Ryan little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
40' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pablo Fornals (Betis). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
33' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
32' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

32' What a save from Mathew Ryan! Hector Bellerin (Betis) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
30' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Antony (Betis) took the corner.
27' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Betis players look gutted.
24' The Betis players halt their celebrations as referee Alejandro Ruiz makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
23' Goal! Sergi Altimira (Betis) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:1.
23' Betis get a corner.
23' Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
22' Hector Bellerin (Betis) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. It's a throw-in for Betis.
21' Nelson Deossa (Betis) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar.
18' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
14' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
12' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.

10' 2 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Etta Eyong (Levante) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the roof of the net and makes it 2:0. Alvaro Valles was helpless.
8' Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the crossbar.
7' The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
7' Hector Bellerin (Betis) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
6' Antony (Betis) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
2' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Carlos Alvarez picks out Ivan Romero (Levante) with a sweet pass, and he latches on to it deep inside the box and beats the goalkeeper. 1:0.
1' Ivan Romero (Levante) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Levante will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Alejandro Ruiz.
